testcase.name: Foreign SafeSpanExporter is rejected at startup instead of being wrapped twice
Single wrapped exporter still acknowledges export mode for a non-batch processor
Non-batch processor keeps the wrapped exporter
Missing captured exporter keeps the incoming processor
Same-runtime identity alone does not prove factory provenance: a manually-built SafeSpanExporter is rejected even when it shares the session runtime (H-4)
Re-entry with this factory's own ReplacementAwareSpanExporter output does not re-wrap or run the boundary a second time
